pages.title: Chapter 4: Cold Forging Process
pages.text: §7[Cold Forging Core Flow]$(br2)Cold forging is the process of shaping metal by hammering at room temperature. The process has three main stages: stretching into sheet, processing into shape, and carving final products.

pages.title: §7[Step 1: Stretch Billet to Sheet]
pages.text: Place softened billet on anvil and left-click with hammer 8 times. The billet will be stretched into a metal sheet.$(br2)Action: Hold hammer, aim at softened billet on anvil, left-click repeatedly. Progress bar shows forging progress.
§bCopper Sheet$(br2)Forged from copper billet by 8 strikes on the anvil. An intermediate product for further processing. Silver and gold sheets follow the same process.

pages.title: §7[Step 2: Process the Sheet]
pages.text: Metal sheets need two processing steps to become carveable:$(br2)$(li)Sheet → §6Curve§r: Right-click sheet on anvil with axe 1 time$(br)$(li)Curve → §6Slot§r: Right-click curve on anvil with axe 1 time$(br2)Curves are for making axes, slots are for making knives, swords, rings, hooks.
§cCopper Curve - Processed from copper sheet, used for making axes or further processing into copper slots.
§cCopper Slot - Processed from copper curve, the base for making knives, swords, rings, hooks.

pages.title: §7[Step 3: Carve Final Product]
pages.text: Use stone chisel to carve the metal on the anvil into final products:$(br2)$(li)Slot + Chisel Left-click 6 times → §6Primitive Knife$(br)$(li)Curve + Chisel Left-click 8 times → §6Axe Head$(br)$(li)Slot + Chisel Left-click 7 times → §6Sword Blade

pages.title: Controls Summary
pages.text: §aHow to operate:$(br2)$(li)Left-click with hammer to forge - stretch billet, forge sheet$(br)$(li)Right-click with axe to process - sheet→curve→slot$(br)$(li)Left-click with chisel to carve - slot→knife/sword, curve→axe
